POWER RESTORATION UPDATE
Affected Areas: Portion of MUF3 - Whole Purok Humayan, Purok Katilingban, Brgy. San Miguel, Murcia
Restored at 3:30 PM
We are pleased to inform our valued consumers that our dedicated team has successfully restored power to the affected areas of today’s scheduled power interruption. This achievement comes ahead of our projected schedule.
We extend our sincere gratitude for your patience, understanding, and continued support throughout the restoration efforts. Your cooperation played a vital role in enabling our teams to work efficiently and safely in the field.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, please do not hesitate to reach out to us. Kindly send your account details and contact number, so we can assist you as soon as possible.
Thank you once again for bearing with us. We remain committed to delivering reliable and improved electric service to our community.
SERVICE BEYOND POWER
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 17, 2026 (Thursday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 17, 2026 (Thursday)
Reason:
● Reconducting of primary bare wire to 1/0 ACSR tree wire; and
● Replacement of one 10kVa common Distribution Transformer to one 50kVa Distribution Transformers 
Time & Affected Areas:
9:00AM to 5:00PM
Portion of MUF3 - Whole Purok Humayan, Purok Katilingban, Brgy. San Miguel, Murcia
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService
